mission_title: Data Stream Blueprint: Head & Body Segments
briefing: Every system needs a blueprint, recruit. Within the main HTML frame, `head` and `body` elements segment critical data. `head` holds metadata, like the system's designation, while `body` contains the visible interface for user interaction. Get it wrong, and the system crashes.
objective: Segment the HTML frame by placing the `title` element within a `head` tag and the `h1` and `p` elements within a `body` tag.

test_assertions: There should be only one `head` element on the page.
There should be only one `body` element on the page.
The `head` element should be a child of the `html` element.
The `body` element should be a child of the `html` element.
The `head` element should wrap around the `title` element.
The `body` element should wrap around both the `h1` and `p` elements.
hints: Think of `head` as the command console for system metadata.
`body` is where the visual payload deploys.
Both `head` and `body` must nest directly within the `html` root.
